statement: At the pinned Linux xpad revision, wired Microsoft vendor 0x045e product 0x0b00 is identified as Xbox One Elite Series 2, uses the Xbox One USB vendor-specific interface/GIP-oriented xpad path and enables the paddle mapping flag. Standard Xbox Series product 0x0b12 instead enables the Share mapping flags; the identities and extra controls are not interchangeable.

applicability.revision: Xbox Elite Series 2 model 1797, software-side revision at pinned sources
applicability.scope: xpad.c:127-134, 494-520, 604-620, 2170-2195; software binding table and parser, not a captured USB descriptor.
